stem.text: The stalk of a dandelion flower is a hollow tube called a scape. Pieces of the scape are cut as shown by the dotted lines and placed in sucrose solutions of different water potentials.

stem.alt: Drawing of a tube in cross-section and in outline, with a hollow centre, thick-walled outer cells, thin-walled inner cells and cut lines

stem.text: Which diagram shows the piece that is placed in the sucrose solution with the highest water potential?

A.alt: Curved strip drawing with thick and thin outlines, labelled outer cells and inner cells

B.alt: Straight strip drawing with thick and thin outlines, labelled inner cells and outer cells

C.alt: Straight strip drawing with a thick upper outline and thin lower outline, labelled outer cells and inner cells

D.alt: Curved strip drawing with thick and thin outlines, labelled inner cells and outer cells
